game.title: Resident Evil 3
game.blurb: Survival horror action game, the 2020 remake of 1999's Resident Evil 3: Nemesis, from Capcom, released 2020-04-02. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Difficulty, Ranks and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing on Standard and Hardcore, S ranks, no item box, few recovery items and under two hours.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2020 remake, with its own Steam app 952060; the Steam schema calls it "E1" (an internal codename). The Steam app list also has "Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999)" as app 4249120, which was not used. StrategyWiki has the remake under "Resident Evil 3 (2020)" (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages but none is written, so nothing was used. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil 3 (2020)" with about 162 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 32 Steam achievements are hidden. "Goodbye, Charlie!" was put with the Charlie Doll collectibles because of its name, and "Conqueror" sits right after "Survivor" and "Veteran" in the Steam list, so it was put with difficulty; both are guesses and need checking. The other 14 hidden ones sit in the story chapter, including two low-percentage ones ("Dominator" 7.8%, "Jill Valentine" 7.1%) that may be harder unlocks rather than story.
